summary: Computes a quadratic force/torque model: given input a2, fills torque *a4 and force components a3[0..2] using quadratic polynomials in a2 plus two absolute-value force components read from object doubles. Gated by an enable byte at this+0x2F8; when disabled all four outputs are zeroed. Called from WheelForceAggregate, CollisionEnergy and SuspensionAndWheelPhysics.

operations.description: Enable gate: when the byte at this+0x2F8 is non-zero compute all outputs, otherwise zero them.
Torque: *a4 = a2 * (double at this+0x324) * a2 + a2 * (double at this+0x31C) + (double at this+0x314) — quadratic in a2.
Force component a3[0] = fabs(double at this+0x34C).
Force component a3[1] = fabs(double at this+0x384).
Force component a3[2] = a2 * (double at this+0x30C) * a2 + a2 * (double at this+0x304) + (double at this+0x2FC) — quadratic in a2.
